newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 324 OF OCTOBER 30, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ C 324 OF OCTOBER 30, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Technical assistance for medical support structures - external provision of services Contract award notice (96/C 324/16)

Phare - design and installation of automatic-information system for travellers Notice of invitation to tender issued by the Commission of the European Union on behalf of the Government of Poland and financed in the framework of the Phare programme (96/C 324/15)

TACIS - state oil and gas management information system Notice of invitation to tender issued by the Commission of the European Communities financed in the framework of the TACIS programme (96/C 324/14)

European network for food safety (RESAL) Notice of invitation to tender concerning the preselection of companies or groups of experts admitted to participate in the restricted tendering process for which invitations will be issued at a later date for completing tasks relating to the implementation and coordination of a European network for food safety (RESAL) Food aid, food safety within the European Community (96/C 324/13)
Studies in the field of validation of alternative methods Contract award notice (96/C 324/12)
Provision of services in connection with the regional activities of the European Commission representation in the United Kingdom Restricted procedure (96/C 324/11)
EUROPEAN ECONOMIC INTEREST GROUPING Notices published pursuant to Council Regulation (EEC) No 2137/85 of 25 July 1985 (1) - Completion of the liquidation (96/C 324/10)
Amendment to the notice of invitation to tender for the refund for the export of common wheat to all third countries except Ceuta, Melilla and certain ACP-States (96/C 324/08)

Draft Council Decision amending Decision 91/116/EEC setting up the European Advisory Committee on statistical information in the economic and social spheres (96/C 324/07) COM(96) 439 final - 96/0223(CNS)
Non-opposition to a notified concentration (Case No IV/M.798 - General Electric/CompuNet) (96/C 324/06)

Recapitulation of current tenders, published in the Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Communities, financed by the European Community under the European Development Fund (EDF) or the European Communities budget (week: 22 to 26 October 1996) (96/C 324/05)
Authorization of State aid pursuant to Articles 92 and 93 of the EC Treaty Proposal to which the Commission has no objection Aid No N 1025/95 - Germany (96/C 324/03)
